tooling.reason: The pin of app-templates follows the adaptations directly on the same branch, which named it as its next commit.
tooling.message:
feat: follow the shared runtime of the templates and pin it

## Intent

The templates now share questions, blocks and a page frame, and a question can show material. The tooling must follow: it referred to the old class names and to published app schemas, and its skills did not know material.

## Key changes

- The visit check treats .question-reveal and .question-actions as the parts only JavaScript shows (they were .quiz-*); its fixtures use the new class.
- The schemas of a quiz and an explainer are no longer published: the build does not copy them, the site page and llms.txt do not list them, and the skills name the file in the app.
- The skills say a quiz adds images to src/images/ and a question shows content with material (figure, labelled figure, table, formula, text, quote, code), with the rules for an image. --page-max-width replaces --interactive-max-width.
- The architecture describes the quiz and the explainer the same way.
- The pin of app-templates moves from 5df0763 to c016140, the merge of lernapps/app-templates#59.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Needs app-templates with the material feature (d156c59). The templates then pin this tooling (1e37d56).

app-templates.message:
chore: pin the tooling to the commit that follows the runtime

## Intent

The templates should be checked by the tooling that knows their new question classes, page frame and material.

## Key changes

- The templates' pin of the tooling moves from d3cc3cf and 9b9a34c to 1e4ba59 (lernapps/tooling#129): the dev dependency of the three templates and of the question-page fixture, the reusable workflow of the change scope, and the classifier of the pre-push hook.
- lernapps check --pre-push passes in the three templates with the new tooling.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Follows the tooling commit of this intent (f32d90d).
